description: The National Energy and Utilities Regulatory Commission of Ukraine publishes yearly results of its monitoring of centralised water supply and sewerage. The page read on 2026-09-28 lists monitoring results for each year from 2020 to 2025, alongside the commission's parallel monitoring of electricity, natural gas, heat supply and service quality. The reports themselves were not opened, so their content, such as licensees' volumes, losses, tariffs, investment or wartime damage, is not confirmed here. Coverage is Ukraine's centralised water supply and sewerage as monitored by the commission. Access is free, and the site states that its content is available under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence unless noted otherwise. Caveats: the series spans the full-scale invasion from 2022, so coverage of occupied or damaged systems may change between years, and the reports are documents, not tables. It supports water utility capacity and resilience studies, such as tracking how licensed water supply and sewerage services changed through years of attacks on power and water systems. Related record: Australia's national performance report for urban water utilities, as a comparable regulator series.
